classification: independent immutable image/file integrity audit; no fresh replay or physical UI acceptance

native.profileProof: Exact same active engine/adapter bytes and unchanged retained build-validation/practice-flow.json; this audit does not perform a fresh replay

method.fileInventory: SHA-256 plus permission mode for regular files; target plus permission mode for symlinks; recursive /app excluding /app/data
method.baseAndCandidate: Separate ephemeral --read-only --network none containers with Node entrypoint; no game service started
method.livePreview: Same static inventory through docker exec; /app/data excluded; no environment or secret values output
method.sourceHashScope: frozenSources records build-time hashes; current test-only differences are explicitly reported as post-build fixtures and are not asserted to be part of the image build

limitations: No new signed replay was run by this integrity audit; exact profile preservation follows byte-identical retained artifacts and receipt.
The Dockerfile defaults to a mutable base tag. Future builds must independently pin/verify the expected image/layer identity as done here.
This audit does not establish physical-device frame pacing, human UI usability or remaining tactical acceptance.

A post-build browser harness can revise event observation without changing runtime/image bytes. Frozen build-source hashes are not hashes of those later browser runs; retain a separate fixture manifest for them.
